name: Structure + OTE pullback

source.label: The Structure + OTE strategy, with the Fibonacci entry, stop and target of the PO3, OTE + ADR model

rules: Only buy while the daily market structure is bullish.
On 4-hour candles, take the latest up-leg of at least 3% and buy when price pulls back through 70.5% of it, the middle of the optimal trade entry zone in its discount half.
Put the stop at the last confirmed 4-hour swing low, and the target at 2.4 times the risk, which from a 70.5% entry is about the top of the leg.
Risk the same 20 USDT on every trade, so a tighter stop buys a larger position.
Hold one position per coin at a time.
notExpressed: The lower-timeframe trigger: a sweep of a swing low followed by a break of structure and an entry on the breaker
Requiring an order block, breaker or fair value gap at the pullback (the point of interest)
The target at the actual swing high: a fixed 2.4R stands in for it
PO3's London and New York session windows and its accumulation-manipulation-distribution read
Moving the stop to breakeven once price closes past the 0.2 level, trailing past the target, and adding a second entry once the first is at breakeven
Short trades in premium (the test is spot, long only)
